parts:

I attach the script down.

Many thanks for any insight.

honestly I am lost

messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Re: Error in DSsim when running a simulation
parts:
Adrian

I couldn't make much progress with your problem as your coordinate file defining the outline of your study area was not provided.  From the code it seems the coordinates are latitude and longitude?  But DSsim operates on coordinates in meters or kilometers.  That is not the cause of your problem, but just an aside. I would attack this part of the problem by sketching out the boundaries of my study area using QGIS, then importing that shape file (properly projected) into R.

If your study design does not include strata, then do not use the strata​ argument in make.region​.

Rather than debugging the entrails of dht.results$Expected.S​, it may be in your interest to leave behind the soon-to-be-deprecated DSsim​ package and move to the bright and sparkling dsims​ package.  The latter package possesses all the capabilities of the old package plus additional features and an easier to use syntax (using the Distance​ package).

See what you think about dsims​ here:
  library(devtools)
  install_github("DistanceDevelopment/dsims")

The package contains a vignette for you to examine. Get back to us if that doesn't get you where you want to go.

messages.author: d6a29bde56bb826d
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Re: Error in DSsim when running a simulation
parts:
Dear Adrian,

I suspect the issue with dht.results$Expected is to do with a fomat change that happened in mrds. This has now been rectified (you might also get a similar issue with the version of dsims on CRAN at present). We are soon to release new versions which will fix this.

For now you can install versions from github to rectify this, installing the updated mrds should fix the issue in both DSsim and dsims. 

devtools::install_github("DistanceDevelopment/mrds") 

I would advise switching to dsims as this is the package that we have developed to replace DSsim. The syntax is very similar, even the same in many places and has the advantage that you do not need to generate the transect shapefiles in advance it uses dssd to do this for you. 

Let me know if this doesn't solve the problem or if you need any further assistance switching to dsims. 

Best wishes,
Laura


Dr. L Marshall

Centre for Research into Ecological & Environmental Modelling

University of St. Andrews

parts:
Hi all

dsims worked well! Problem solved

It took a while ot translate the "old" DSsim orders into dsims but nothing critical.

As Laura said, by now it is mandatory to load package mrds from Github instead from CRAN. Otherwise the dht.results issues reappear.

Many many thanks.

By the way. I am still using wisp to teach plot sampling.... 
Great package for teaching the basis of sampling. I can make it run up to R 3.6.3
